correctness.rationale: The F5 Sziklai equality classification reduces every eligible smooth 16-point quartic to the diagonal X^4+Y^4+3Z^4. The 12 hyperflex lines from s^4=4,2,2 and 16 ordinary bitangents indexed by two fourth roots of 2 exhaust 28 theta-contact lines; restricting the quartic proves their double-contact equations directly. Frobenius s↦s^5 multiplies roots of 4 by −1 and roots of 2 by 2, so the complete permutation is two 2-cycles and six 4-cycles, and extension counts are 0,4,28 at degrees 1,2,4. Independent arithmetic of Frobenius translation classes reproduced the exact cycle and extension counts; all-rational-model uniqueness comes from Ferreira–Speziali rather than brute force.
